subject: NebulaWare white-label runtime: certification steps and pre-launch checklist
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena@nebulaware.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Partner inquiry: white-label runtime embed

Hi Priya,

I’m Lena, Head of Product at NebulaWare — we build a data science IDE used by large enterprises. Our product team is exploring a white-label conversational runtime to embed into our workspace; Redwood came highly recommended by a couple of teams here. We’re especially interested in: runtime footprint for an on-prem SKU, certs/SOC2 alignment, and commercial terms for a co-branded runtime.

High-level asks:
- Can you share a checklist of technical and legal artifacts you require for a partner OEM?
- Do you support a private deployment (VPC/on-prem) with a local control plane?
- What are the latency and throughput profiles for a 4xA100 equivalent allocation?

We have some timeline constraints: pilot in August, GA in November. Happy to hop on a 30-min sync next week. I’ve CC’d our procurement alias for any initial paperwork.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Head of Product, NebulaWare
lena@nebulaware.com
(attachment: Nebula_NDA_v3.docx)

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.ai

Cc: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai, procurement@nebulaware.com
Date: 2026-06-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partner inquiry: white-label runtime embed

Hi Lena — great to meet you over email.

We’d love to explore this. Quick answers up front: yes, we support private deployments (VPC and on-prem packaging) and have an enterprise certification pack (SOC 2, ISO references) we share with partners. For the pilot timeline your August target is feasible — typically: integration + security review in 6–8 weeks, pilot for 4 weeks, then GA prep.

I’ll propose a 30-min slot for next Tue/Thu. For the checklist, I’m attaching our partner onboarding checklist and a high-level technical integration brief. Karthik (cc’d) will own the integration plan and capacity sizing; Jasmine will help with commercial/telemetry requirements.

Action items:
- Please countersign the NDA (attached) and send any security questionnaires you have.
- Share target SLOs (p95 latency) and expected concurrent sessions for the pilot.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.ai

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Lena Ortiz <lena@nebulaware.com>, priya_natarajan@redwood.ai
Cc: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-06-18T13:28:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Partner inquiry: white-label runtime embed — integration notes\n
Hi Lena / team — quick technical primer from the integration side.

We typically integrate in two phases:
1) Proof-of-concept (cloud private deployment or customer-managed VPC with hybrid control plane) — we provide a container bundle + bootstrap scripts.
2) Hardened on-prem SKU for GA (installer + KMS/HSM integrations, telemetry opt-in).

For your ask about a 4xA100-equivalent pool:
- Expected p95 generation latency for 1k token responses: ~220-320ms depending on model variant and batching.
- Sustained concurrent sessions: roughly 35–50 interactive sessions with small inference sizes; we can increase concurrency with batching but will tradeoff tail latency.

Integration checklist (technical items):
- Network: Allowlisted egress endpoints for license checks and telemetry (list in attachment).
- Secrets: KMS integration details or HSM certificate exchange.
- Storage: local kv-cache mount points and retention policy.
- Telemetry: token-level cost breakouts, per-route latency metrics (we can limit what is sent for white-label).

Please share your expected concurrent sessions and target p95 so we can size the pilot config. Also, any compliance docs (SOC 2 cert) would speed legal review.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer, Director, Product Engineering — Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_network_endpoints.csv)

From: Tom Becker <t.becker@nebulaware.com>

- Expected concurrent interactive sessions for pilot: 40 (peak), average 18.
- Target p95 latency: <350ms for 1k token typical responses.
- Deployment preference: start with VPC private deployment; we may move to on-prem installer for GA.

Attachments: NebulaWare_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (completed), Pilot_Sizing.xlsx (stub). Also shared a Drive folder with config samples: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNEBULA-WORKSPACE

On commercial: we’re initially looking for a 12-month committed capacity with an option to convert to a revenue-share bundled SKU at GA. Procurement will follow up on pricing and the NDA.

Tom Becker
